- **Notice text:** It writes a short letter that opens "Dear parent or guardian," and says "Ana Rivera was absent for 2 days:". Below that is a bulleted list of dates like "September 3, 2026", oldest first. It says "1 day" when there is only one.

after.tests/test_notices.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import build_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("1001", "Rivera", "Ana", "A")

def make_mark(text, status, owner="1001"):
    return Mark(owner, date.fromisoformat(text), status)

class BuildNoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_names_count_and_ordered_dates(self):
        marks = [
            make_mark("2026-09-08", "absent"),
            make_mark("2026-09-02", "present"),
            make_mark("2026-09-03", "absent")
        ]
        text = build_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ana Rivera", text)
        self.assertIn("absent for 2 days", text)
        early = text.index("September 3, 2026")
        late = text.index("September 8, 2026")
        self.assertLess(early, late)
        self.assertNotIn("September 2,", text)

    def test_single_day_is_singular(self):
        text = build_notice(
            PUPIL, [make_mark("2026-09-03", "absent")]
        )
        self.assertIn("absent for 1 day:", text)

    def test_excused_days_are_ignored(self):
        marks = [
            make_mark("2026-09-03", "excused"),
            make_mark("2026-09-04", "absent")
        ]
        self.assertIn("1 day", build_notice(PUPIL, marks))

    def test_foreign_mark_rejected(self):
        marks = [
            make_mark("2026-09-03", "absent"),
            make_mark("2026-09-04", "absent", "1002")
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        marks = [make_mark("2026-09-03", "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, [])
